resources.string: Press both volume keys together to park what\'s on screen

Lets you save what\'s on screen to Kite\'s parking lot from any app: press volume up and volume down together, tap the Park tile in Quick Settings, or use the accessibility button. When you do, Kite takes a screenshot and reads the text and any link on screen to make the card. Nothing is read at any other time, and nothing leaves your phone.
